zh-CN.title: 运营者联系与禁言记录
items: 添加好友页会展示空间运营者及双方好友状态，任何成员均可直接发起好友申请

en.title: Operator contacts and mute records
items: Add Friend now lists space operators and friendship status, allowing every member to send a request
Square mute records now identify the official account or operator who performed the action
